data.notes: April 2027 is already anchored by a new RAYE-led Access All Areas festival, early confirmed club-programming around May Day, and a strong German rap/pop concert run.

events.title: Access All Areas
events.summary: Zalando launches Access All Areas, a two-day music, fashion and culture festival across Station Berlin and Tempodrom, with RAYE announced as headliner. Zalando confirms 24–25 April 2027 and up to 40,000 visitors expected.

events.title: Maffay + Oerding - Nashville Live 2027
events.summary: Peter Maffay and Johannes Oerding bring their Nashville project to Uber Arena. The arena confirms the Berlin concert for 17 April 2027 at 20:00.

events.title: Trettmann - Stadt aus Gold
events.summary: Trettmann brings his Stadt aus Gold show to UFO im Velodrom. Eventim confirms the Berlin date for 4 April 2027 at 20:00.

events.title: Snarky Puppy - Tour 2027
events.summary: Snarky Puppy perform at Columbiahalle as part of their 2027 tour. The band's official tour page lists Columbiahalle, Berlin for 13 April 2027.

events.title: Simple Minds - European Tour Live 2027
events.summary: Simple Minds play Uber Arena on their European Tour Live 2027. Eventim confirms the Berlin date for 21 April 2027 at 19:45.

events.title: AK Ausserkontrolle - Auf die Harte Tour
events.summary: Berlin street-rap artist AK Ausserkontrolle plays a hometown UFO im Velodrom date on his Auf die Harte Tour. The venue confirms the 3 April 2027 show with 18:30 doors and 20:00 start.

events.title: PiepShow - AprilPiep
events.summary: Monthly PiepShow queer techno rave at KitKatClub, advertised as a 14-hour party with multiple dancefloors and techno/house sounds.

events.title: Weltauswahl by Extrawelt
events.summary: Extrawelt headlines a live techno edition of Weltauswahl at Ritter Butzke. Resident Advisor confirms the 10 April 2027 event and the 22:00–08:00 runtime.

events.title: Passenger - Wild Love Tour
events.summary: Passenger, the project of Mike Rosenberg, plays Tempodrom on the Wild Love Tour. The venue confirms the 17 April 2027 show with 18:30 doors and 20:00 start.

events.title: SMALL GREAT HOUSE FESTIVAL 'Open Air & Indoor +53H Non-Stop' + Special Guests
events.summary: A 53-hour open-air and indoor house/disco weekender at OXI from Small Great Things, returning after its first edition with classic house headliners and side programming promised.

events.title: LUNE - Überlebt Tour 2027
events.summary: German-French pop/R&B artist LUNE brings the Überlebt Tour to Tempodrom. The venue confirms the 15 April 2027 date, 18:00 doors and 19:30 start.

events.title: 1986zig - Ich komme nach Hause Tour
events.summary: German masked singer/rapper 1986zig performs at Columbiahalle on the Ich komme nach Hause Tour. Eventim confirms the 22 April 2027 Berlin show at 20:00.

events.title: BCCO x future.666
events.summary: BCCO teams with future.666 for a May Day weekend session at Haus der Visionäre, billed as all night and all day long with b2bs. Resident Advisor confirms the 30 April 2027 date and 22:00–08:00 runtime.

events.title: Wa22ermann - KNAX Tour 2026
events.summary: Berlin rapper Wa22ermann brings her rescheduled KNAX tour to Festsaal Kreuzberg. The venue listing confirms the 1 April 2027 date, 19:00 doors and 20:00 start.

events.title: GOAT BALL 1ST OF MAI XXL EDITION
events.summary: GOAT BALL’s May Day XXL edition at Lokschuppen Berlin is confirmed as a long-format Apr 30–May 2 party, with trance/electronica billing and lineup still TBA.

events.title: Audio88 - Erste Solo Tour
events.summary: Audio88 plays Lido on his first solo tour after years with Audio88 & Yassin. Eventim confirms the Berlin concert for 25 April 2027 at 20:00.

events.title: Dent May (US / Carpark Records)
events.summary: Dent May plays Kantine am Berghain with support, presented by Crunch Tapes and Positive Transmitter. Resident Advisor confirms the 22 April 2027 date and 20:00–23:00 runtime.

events.title: WHALIEN
events.summary: A confirmed April techno listing for WHALIEN at Suicide Circus Berlin, dated Apr 23–24 on TicketSwap’s Berlin techno calendar.
